guidance: Harsh Vardhan Sarda: In the next 2 years, we are targeting to reach a revenu e of around INR500 crores.
And revenue, we expect to be around INR3 crores to INR4 crores annually additional revenue.
capex: Harsh Vardhan Sarda: Q2 growth was primarily from volume because of expansion i n product categories and our production capacities as well in existing product categories.
And capex is around INR2,500 to INR3,000 per square feet.
risks: See, currently, because of the raw material p rices being on the higher side, we are seeing some challenges in growing margin.
focus: Over the past year, we have continued to build on our business fundamentals while focusing on expanding our market presence and strengthening our capabilities.
Together, these initi atives will help us broaden our product reach, diversify our sales channels and make DOREME products more accessible to our customers.
Our approach will remain measured with a focus on identifying suitable partners and establishing sustainable distribution channels.

about: IRIS Clothings Limited, incorporated in 1956, is engaged in designing, manufacturing, branding and selling garments for kids. [1] Iris Clothings Limited is a fast-growing readymade garment company and is engaged in designing, manufacturing, branding and selling garments for kids wear under the brand name DOREME in India. It produces a broad range of unique apparels for infants, toddlers and junior boys and girls.
